source.name: Natural Cure
source.originalDescription: Automatically cleanses this Pokémon every 6s, even if there are no effects to cleanse. Removes all status condition from the Pokémon. This ability goes on cooldown after it's triggered.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Natural Cure には、直接ダメージや単純移動以外の特殊効果を検出していません。

source.originalDescription: The user pounds in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and decreasing their movement speed by 40% for 2s. Has the user attack by pounding in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and decreasing their movement speed for a short time when it hits.

source.name: Heal Pulse

source.name: Bliss Assistance
source.originalDescription: The user becomes unstoppable and dashes to the designated ally Pokémon to give it an egg, granting that ally a shield and increasing their Attack and Sp. Atk by 20% for 6s. The user also intercepts 50% of the post-mitigation damage received by that ally as unmitigated damage for 6s. While dashing, opposing Pokémon hit are damaged and thrown into the air for 0.8s. When reaching the target ally, nearby opposing Pokémon are damaged again. Has the user dash to the designated ally to give it an egg, granting that ally a shield and increasing its Attack and Sp. Attack for a short time. The user also intercepts a portion of the damage received by that ally for a short time. While dashing, the user throws nearby enemies and those it comes in contact with. Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Bliss Assistance は 相手を打ち上げる、妨害無効になる、攻撃・特攻などのステータスを変化させる、受けるダメージを軽減する、待ち時間を短縮する、シールドを付与する、味方へ付着または移動する。
